title: Google Fitbit Edge: The Ultimate Smart Fitness Tracker
summary: Google Fitbit Edge is a slim fitness tracker with GPS, an ECG app and a seven-day battery. This blog covers its specs, features, Premium coaching, comparisons and Bangladesh availability at Star Tech.
intro: Google Fitbit Edge is a slim tracker for those who want more than a band but less than a smartwatch.
html:
Google has officially introduced the Google Fitbit Edge, a slim new fitness band designed to hit the sweet spot between a displayless fitness tracker and a full smartwatch.

Plenty of fitness enthusiasts want more than a basic smart band but less than a full smartwatch. Google Fitbit Edge is built to fill that gap. It costs $179.99 in the US and reaches shelves on Oct 27, 2026. It offers a bright screen, built-in GPS, ECG, and a seven-day battery life in an 11.5 mm body. It also focuses on repairability, which could make it easier to maintain over time. The Google Fitbit Edge is ideal for fitness enthusiasts who want detailed health tracking without the bulk of a full smartwatch. It suits runners, gym-goers, and health-conscious users who value built-in GPS, workout guidance, sleep tracking, and recovery insights. In this blog, we’ll cover its key features and help you decide whether it fits your fitness goals and daily routine.

Google Fitbit Edge Key Specs at a Glance

The Google Fitbit Edge brings together key features for everyday health tracking and fitness training. Before we look at each feature in detail, here’s a quick overview of its main specs, including the display, GPS, battery life, design, and health-tracking features.

SpecDetails
Display1.34-inch (34 mm) AMOLED color display, always on, backlit, adjustable brightness.
BatteryUp to 7 days, built-in rechargeable lithium-ion cell, user-replaceable.
ChargingFull charge in about 90 minutes. 5 minutes of charging gives up to 1 day when the battery is low.
ConnectivityBluetooth 5.4, GPS, and Galileo
Memory64 MB NOR flash. Stores 7 days of minute-by-minute motion data and 30 days of daily totals and heart rate at 2-second intervals.
SensorsAltimeter, accelerometer, gyroscope, red and infrared SpO2 sensors, electrical sensors for the ECG app, optical (PPG) heart rate sensor, ambient light sensor, far-field skin temperature sensor
Fitness featuresFloor and elevation tracking, GPS for outdoor workouts, cardio load, readiness, active zone minutes, VO2 max, 24/7 and resting heart rate, live heart rate on exercise equipment, post-workout summary
Health featuresECG app, AFib detection, irregular, high, and low heart rate notifications, SpO2, skin temperature, advanced sleep tracking, cycle tracking, monthly blood pressure, and insulin resistance trends (premium)
Phone supportAndroid 11 or newer, iOS 16.4 or newer. Needs a Google Account and the Google Health app.

Design and Display

Slim Aluminum Body

The first thing you notice about the Google Fitbit Edge is its slim profile. The case measures 11.5mm, and Google says it's 45% lighter than the Apple Watch Series 12. Google says the housing is 100% recycled aluminum. It also curves with your wrist, and Google calls it comfortable for all-day and overnight wear. That matters if you plan to wear it to bed for sleep tracking.

Largest and Brightest Screen

Google calls the largest and brightest tracker screen it has made in Fitbit Edge, with 46% more viewing area than earlier Fitbit trackers. It stays readable in direct sunlight, which helps on midday runs. The Google Fitbit Edge redesigned side button gives you a real click, so you can pause a workout without looking down. Tiles show sleep, cycle tracking, and heart rate at a glance. You also get media controls and call and message notifications. Google lists Google Maps turn-by-turn directions as coming soon.

Colors and Bands

You can choose from four Fitbit Edge finishes. Obsidian has a matte black aluminum case, Fog is satin silver, Olive is satin pyrite, and Canyon is champagne gold. Bands swap easily. Google offers Active Sport, Magnet, and Metal Links bands, and a Performance Loop band is coming soon. Extra bands are sold separately. If you follow basketball, the Google Fitbit Edge Stephen Curry Special Edition adds rye tones and game-day orange to a recycled polyester band with stainless steel lugs. Google says its water-repellent coating can wear off over time.

Fitness Tracking Features

50+ Exercise Modes With Live Guidance

The live guidance adapts to what you're doing. Pilates shows core metrics. Runs show pace targets. HIIT shows heart rate zones, and track sessions show splits. Google says the stats stay clear without breaking your stride on Fitbit Edge.

Built-In GPS and Altimeter

Runners will care about this part most. Fitbit Edge GPS accuracy is Google's main upgrade, with tracking up to 40% more accurate than earlier generations, even without your phone. Google credits an upgraded GPS chipset and nano-molded aluminum housing. An altimeter adds elevation data, so hill sprints, outdoor runs, and stair workouts show your real effort.

Automatic Workout Detection

The Google Fitbit Edge can still catch your workout. It recognizes and sorts up to 100 workouts on its own, from outdoor runs and rides to daily walks. Google says its next-generation intelligence reads your activity context and counts the effort toward your weekly goals. The numbers differ because you can start more than 50 modes yourself, while the Fitbit detects up to 100 automatically.

Health Sensors and Health Guardian

ECG and Continuous Heart Rate

The Fitbit Edge ECG app records your heart rhythm from your wrist whenever you want. Check availability first. Google says the app works only in select countries, and it isn't for people under 22. Between ECG checks, continuous optical heart rate monitoring tracks your rest and recovery around the clock. Like any optical sensor, it can lose accuracy depending on your body type, how you wear it, and how much you move. Google also says high- and low-heart-rate alerts aren't available in every country.

Sleep, HRV, and Skin Temperature

The Google Fitbit Edge reads your sleep with a few extra sensors. A dedicated skin temperature sensor tracks changes overnight. Google combines that with sleep stages and heart rate variability, or HRV, to give you a recovery score each morning. HRV measures the small timing gaps between heartbeats. It varies widely from person to person, so follow your own trend instead of comparing it with friends. Skin temperature shows changes from your normal range, not a fever. Google also warns that big swings in room temperature can affect the data.

Blood Pressure and Insulin Resistance Trends

Health Guardian runs quietly in the background and alerts you when something shifts. Google lists high and low heart rate alerts, Irregular Rhythm Notifications, Loss of Pulse Detection and Breathing Emergency alerts. On its store page, Google places blood pressure and insulin resistance trends, tracked monthly, under Premium. Keep the limits in mind. Google calls these wellness tools. They don't diagnose anything, replace a doctor, or serve as a screening test for diabetes or hypertension. Google also says pregnant women shouldn't use the trend features on Fitbit Edge. Availability varies by country and device.

Battery Life and Charging

Google rates Fitbit Edge battery life at up to seven days per charge so that you can leave the charger at home for a weekend trip. That number comes from Google's tests on pre-production units, so expect your result to vary. Low on power? Five minutes on the magnetic charger gives about a day of use with the in-box USB-C cable and a separately sold 30W adapter. The Edge is also Google's first repairable fitness tracker. It has a modular design and a replaceable battery.

Google Health Premium and the Health Coach

Every Fitbit Edge purchase comes with three months of Google Health Premium. The Fitbit Edge Google Health Premium offer unlocks the Google Health Coach, which needs the Google Health app and an internet connection. Google says the Coach helps you spot shifts in your patterns, adjust your fitness plan, and provide context for doctor visits. Premium also adds advanced Health Guardian trends, nutrition coaching that works with compatible glucose monitors, medical record summaries, and a workout video library. You must be 18 or older to enroll. Gemini responses can be wrong, and Google tells you to check them. See g.co/fitbit/edgesupport for the current list of features that need Premium.

Price and Availability

The Fitbit Edge price in Bangladesh isn't confirmed yet. We found no local listings as of Oct 13, 2026. In the US, the Edge costs $179.99, and the Fitbit Edge Stephen Curry edition costs $219.99. Every purchase includes three months of Google Health Premium.

The Fitbit Edge releases Oct 27, 2026, when it hits shelves in the US. Pre-orders opened on Oct 12 through the Google Store and retail partners, and the store page still shows a pre-order button as of Oct 13, 2026.

Star Tech has already listed the Fitbit Edge as upcoming, but no Bangladesh release date is confirmed. Once it goes on sale, you can order online from Star Tech at the best price in Bangladesh for delivery across Bangladesh, or visit a showroom.

Fitbit Edge vs Fitbit Air vs Pixel Watch 5

Google puts the Edge between its other two wearables, so the choice comes down to what you want on your wrist. The Fitbit Edge vs Pixel Watch 5 is a question of how much smartwatch you need. The Edge builds on the interface Google introduced with the Pixel Watch 5, but the Pixel Watch stays the advanced smartwatch. Fitbit Edge vs Fitbit Air comes down to the screen. The Air has none, so you read your data in the app.

Who Should Buy the Google Fitbit Edge?

Is Fitbit Edge worth buying? It depends on how you train and how you sleep. Runners and gym regulars get GPS that works without a phone, plus pace targets and heart rate zones on the wrist. If you care about sleep and recovery, you get skin temperature, HRV and a morning recovery score.

Skip it if you want apps and a bigger display. The Pixel Watch 5 is a better fit. Skip it if you want no screen at all. The Fitbit Air does that for less. Wait, if you plan to rely on ECG or Health Guardian features in Bangladesh, availability varies by country.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS)

Question-1:

What is the price of Google Fitbit Edge?

The standard Google Fitbit Edge costs $179.99 in the US. The Stephen Curry Special Edition costs $219.99. Its official Bangladesh price has not been confirmed.

Question-2:

How long does the Google Fitbit Edge battery last?

Google rates the Fitbit Edge for up to seven days of battery life. Actual results depend on usage, settings, and enabled features.

Question-3:

Does Google Fitbit Edge have built-in GPS?

Yes. The tracker has built-in GPS and supports Galileo. It can record outdoor workout routes without using your phone for location tracking.

Question-4:

Does Google Fitbit Edge support ECG?

Yes. The Fitbit Edge supports an ECG app in select countries. Google states that the feature is not intended for users under 22.

Question-5:

Is Google Fitbit Edge compatible with iPhone?

The Fitbit Edge works with most iPhones running iOS 16.4 or newer. It also supports most Android phones running Android 11 or newer. A Google Account and the Google Health app are required.

Question-6:

Is Google Fitbit Edge waterproof?

Google lists 5 ATM and IP68 ratings for the Fitbit Edge. These ratings indicate water and dust resistance under specified conditions, not complete protection in every situation. Follow Google's care instructions before swimming or exposing the tracker to water.

Question-7:

Does Google Fitbit Edge require a subscription?

Basic tracking features do not all require Premium. However, Google Health Coach and certain advanced health features require Google Health Premium. Check the current feature list for details.

Question-8:

Is Google Fitbit Edge available in Bangladesh?

Google's official Bangladesh price and release date have not been confirmed in the information available for this article. Check official announcements and local retailers for updates.
